title: Noise kernel sums to one over the cube
statement:
Fix a correlation parameter $\rho$ with $0 \le \rho \le 1$ and a point $y$ in the Boolean hypercube $\{0,1\}^n$. Then summing the noise kernel over all $x$ in the cube gives
\[
  \sum_{x \in \{0,1\}^n} K_\rho(x,y) \;=\; 1,
\]
so that for each fixed $y$ the values $K_\rho(\cdot,y)$ form a probability distribution on the hypercube.
hypotheses_covered: $y$ a fixed point of the Boolean hypercube $\{0,1\}^n$
